description: Shared with all collaborators. Env-drift guard reports at session start when the local gitignored .env disagrees with .env.example or with the main checkout, naming keys only and never values (issue #97); it does not fire on compaction. Destructive-git guard turns the AGENTS.md Critical Do-Nots into enforcement rather than prose (issue #258): it denies force pushes and filter-branch outright, and prompts for hard resets, force branch deletes, force cleans and wholesale working-tree discards, so an agent still cannot do any of them silently but a human can approve the ones AGENTS.md permits. It deliberately permits plain pushes and gh pr merge so neither lane breaks. A denial cannot be worked around with the `!` prefix, which goes through the same hook. House-style guard blocks Edit/Write content that introduces an em dash or emoji. Impeccable design detector runs immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write/MultiEdit on UI files and a full-rule deep pass on Stop.
